column1: # THE CL SHARD WALLS: each package of the CL tier (the living tree, `go run
# ./tools/ci select-packages --all`) and its wall in seconds, the package-level
# Elapsed of `go test -json`, on the last green run that ran it uncached.
# A CI shard is cancelled at two minutes (ci.yml timeout-minutes: 2) and the
# Makefile's test target stops a package at 110 s (GOTEST_TIMEOUT), so no CL
# package may take more than 60 s: internal/ci TestEveryCLPackageFitsItsShardWall
# refuses a row over 60, a live package with tests and no row, and a row for a
# package the tree no longer holds. A package that grew past 60 s is made to fit
# or has its slow tests moved behind the `slow` build tag (nightly-slow.yml runs
# them) before its row changes; the row is never raised past the cap.
# Columns, tab-separated: package, seconds, where it was measured -- @run<id>
# is the GitHub Actions run whose test step logged it (gh run view <id> --log),
# @local is a local run on a bench machine (go test -count=1 -p 2, one package at a
# time, niced) for a package every recent CI run served from Go's test cache.
# Measured 2026-10-06; a package with no unit tests (only build-tagged ones)
